verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Ingestion API explicitly supports 'historical imports' alongside live events and user profile data, and Warehouse Connectors allow syncing historical data from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and Postgres directly into Mixpanel. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of import from other named analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude/GA) or size/rate-limit specifics for bulk historical imports, and no independent hands-on report confirming a large-scale migration.
